add_faiss_index: add a faiss dense vector index to a dataset column for fast similarity retrieval
add_elasticsearch_index: add an elasticsearch bm25 text index to a dataset column for fast text retrieval
search_index: search a faiss or elasticsearch index on a dataset and return scores and indices
get_nearest_examples: get the nearest examples and their scores from a dataset index given a query
save_and_load_faiss_index: save a faiss index to disk or remote uri and load it back into a dataset
